subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The museum’s __archive__ is a great place to find valuable artifacts such as ancient manuscripts.

options.text: A room to store lots of books
A room to store important official documents
A collection of historical documents or records

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"archive"** refers to a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people. It can include manuscripts, documents, letters, and other items that are preserved because of their historical importance. (संग्रहणालय)
 
 
• **Example: **The national archive houses all the important documents related to the country's history.
 
 
 
• The sentence mentions finding **"valuable artifacts such as ancient manuscripts"** in the museum’s archive, which aligns with the definition of an archive as a collection of historical documents or records. (ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज़ या रिकॉर्ड)
 
 
• **Example: **The archive contained rare manuscripts dating back to the 15th century.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct meaning of "archive" in the given context is a collection of historical documents or records.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A collection of essays **(निबंधों का संग्रह): This refers to a compilation of essays, which are short pieces of writing on a particular subject.
 
 
• **Example:** She published a collection of essays on modern art.
 
 
 
• **A room to store lots of books **(पुस्तकों को संग्रहित करने के लिए एक कमरा): This typically refers to a library or a storage room specifically for books.
 
 
• **Example: **The old mansion had a large room dedicated to storing the family's extensive book collection.
 
 
 
• **A room to store important official documents** (महत्वपूर्ण आधिकारिक दस्तावेज़ों को संग्रहित करने के लिए एक कमरा): This can refer to a specific area within an archive or a records room in an organization where official documents are kept.
 
 
• **Example:** The company's records room contains all the contracts and legal documents.
